title: Liver function tests (ALT, AST, bilirubin)
what: This is a blood test from a vein. It shows how well your liver works and whether it is inflamed.
why: For weakness, yellowish skin, pain under the right ribs, while taking certain medicines, or at a checkup.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; results usually come the next day
tell_doctor: What medicines, vitamins, and herbs you take
If you had hard workouts in the last few days
If your liver tests were abnormal before. Bring your past results

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually fasting: no food for 8 to 12 hours. Plain water is fine. Check with the lab.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: For 1 to 2 days, no alcohol and no fatty or fried food. No hard workouts.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Tell your doctor what you take. They will decide if anything should change.

bring: Past test results, if you have them
steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tightened above your elbow
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
A quick prick, and blood fills a tube
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes and keep your arm straight
You can eat right away and go back to your usual day
Results usually come in 1 day. The lab will tell you when
Your doctor will explain what the numbers mean

faq.a: There are many reasons: fatty food, alcohol, medicines, exercise, or liver disease. Your doctor will sort it out. Often the test is simply repeated.

faq.q: Can I drink coffee before the test?
faq.a: No, if the test is fasting. Plain water only.

reminders.text: Liver tests tomorrow. Do not eat after dinner. Plain water is fine.
